request: Generic UUID validation must accept syntactically valid hexadecimal UUID text regardless of letter case, including mixed case, while rejecting malformed text.

defects.description: The generic UUID regular expression permits only lowercase a-f, rejecting valid uppercase and mixed-case hexadecimal UUIDs.
defects.why_missed: Lowercase happy-path UUIDs and case-aware RFC4122-specific validators pass; they do not exercise the generic uuid validator with uppercase or mixed-case input.
